about: Seed task-type tree for the team-shape skill (ONEIRON-ARCH-0079, ONE TASK TYPE). Every spawn and task receipt carries a typeRef: a node id and this tree_version. The Dreamer splits a node when its tasks disagree on a decision read from the tree, merges siblings that agree, and names each new node. Nodes split on decisions, never on topic.

modifiers.uncertainty: high or low. High favours more makers and contests.
modifiers.solo_baseline: above or below about 45%. Above it, extra agents tend to hurt.

nodes.name: all tasks
nodes.test: Any task. A task the placement skill cannot place with confidence stays here.

nodes.name: GENERATE
nodes.test: Many options are needed; the best one matters; no checker yet.

nodes.name: REFINE
nodes.test: Improve an existing artifact or extend existing work.

nodes.name: SOLVE
nodes.test: One right answer, and a check can confirm it.

nodes.name: RESEARCH
nodes.test: The facts are spread across many sources.

nodes.name: JUDGE
nodes.test: No check now; the truth arrives later or is a judgment.

nodes.name: BUILD
nodes.test: One coherent artifact with chained constraints.

nodes.name: NEGOTIATE
nodes.test: Goals or views conflict, and one must be chosen.
